# 1.38.0-beta.7

The seventh beta brings deep research to chat, a new logo, and panoramic backgrounds.

## Chat

- Use `/research` to see a research plan and then investigate the topic with the chat tools. OpenRouter search settings now offer Exa Deep Reasoning.
- Chat can call tools from enabled MCP servers with the same permissions and confirmations.
- With model inheritance on, `/agent` uses the resolved chat model. An explicit tier selects its configured agent model.
- Long numbered Markdown lists display the complete number.

## Appearance

- The app has a new logo and the message composer has more room.
- Use a 2:1 panorama as the background and adjust the view and its response to the pointer.
- The context compaction screen shows which part of the model context will be summarized and animates the resulting change.
